reports.title: National Accounts Estimates (Mauritius)
reports.description: Statistics Mauritius's quarterly national accounts release (Economic and Social Indicators series). June 2026 issue (ESI Issue No. 1937): 'Concepts and definitions used in the computation of estimates in this issue are given at section 6.3 and are according to the United Nations System of National Accounts (SNA) 2008 manual.' The same issue notes the forthcoming September 2026 CEA-2023 benchmark revision 'will incorporate some of the recommendations of the System of National Accounts 2025 (SNA 2025)', confirming SNA 2008 is the current, not superseded, standard as of this release. Quote raw-verified 2026-08-22 (statsmauritius.govmu.org PDF).
reports.cadence_note: Quarterly ESI release; base-period benchmark revisions (e.g. CEA-2023, expected September 2026) are periodic methodology updates layered on the same quarterly cadence, not a separate publication.

dependencies.basis: Statistics Mauritius, National Accounts Estimates, June 2026 (ESI Issue No. 1937): 'Concepts and definitions used in the computation of estimates in this issue are given at section 6.3 and are according to the United Nations System of National Accounts (SNA) 2008 manual.' Quote raw-verified 2026-08-22.
